% A node of fixed text width, centred, with struts at both ends: LaTeX's
% \par asks \lastnodetype after \strut, and its line must stay one line.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\node[draw,rounded corners=10pt,text width=1.9cm,align=center,
  execute at begin node=\strut,execute at end node=\strut] (d) at (0,0) {A\\B};
\end{tikzpicture}
\gdef\SatexReachedEnd{}
\end{document}
